landingScope.filterHelp: A SQL condition on this table's own columns. Its replica holds only the rows that pass it; leave empty to land every row.
landingScope.argumentsHelp: Arguments the API takes by name, sent on every read of this table, as a JSON object. A table whose arguments are all fixed lands whole.
landingScope.argumentsNotObject: Give a JSON object of argument names and values
landingScope.readWaitHelp: What a read does while none of this table has landed. Waits as long as the request allows by default; it can instead wait a time of its own, or answer no rows with the table's columns and start the landing.
landingScope.readWaitTimed: Wait up to a set time
landingScope.readWaitNoRows: Answer no rows and start the landing
